title: Not Cleared
logline: A young man obsessed with aviation passes every stage of a sponsored trainee pilot program except the eye exam, and finds he has not stopped looking up.
audience: Young Ethiopians who have been told no on a dream, plus my family and my cohort. Watched on a phone, vertical, often with sound low.
intent: At the end they should feel that a rejection closes one runway, not the sky.

style.style_block: warm hand-painted illustration, soft gouache texture, gentle film grain, golden-hour light, muted ochre and teal palette, subject centred in frame, no text, no letters, no logos

character.description: a 25-year-old Ethiopian Habesha man from Addis Ababa, slim, deep brown skin, short tightly curled black hair, a short neat black beard, East African facial features, wearing a navy blue jacket over a white shirt
character.reference_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of one single person only, front view, looking at the viewer, plain light background

voice.name: Charon
voice.style_instruction: Read this in a calm, warm, unhurried voice, like someone remembering something personal

shots.reason: Establishes Addis at dawn and the dream: a plane drawing a line in the sky.
shots.image_prompt: Addis Ababa rooftops at dawn, a tiny figure standing on a flat roof looking up, a distant airliner drawing a long white contrail across a pink and gold sky
shots.motion_prompt: the contrail slowly extends across the sky, camera static, gentle morning haze
shots.narration: Every morning, planes drew white lines across the sky over Addis. I used to think they were writing to me.

shots.reason: Shows the obsession was for love, not study: absorbed in a documentary at midnight, not posing for the camera.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, seen from the side in profile, sitting on the floor of a small dark bedroom at midnight with his back against the bed, a laptop on his knees playing a documentary of an airliner taking off, the cool blue screen glow lighting his face, absorbed and quietly smiling, a paper model airplane on the shelf behind him
shots.motion_prompt: screen light flickers softly on his face, camera slowly pushes in
shots.narration: So I chased them. Documentaries at midnight, not to study, just to be near it. Whatever I could find online, I read.

shots.reason: One concrete image of devotion, compared to something everyone knows.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, wide view, the young man sitting on a rooftop edge in late afternoon, watching a distant airliner descending to land
shots.motion_prompt: the airliner descends slowly in the distance, camera static
shots.narration: I watched landings the way other kids watched football.

shots.reason: The door opens: he applies to the sponsored trainee pilot program.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, medium shot, the young man in a white shirt and tie under his navy jacket, sitting in a bright waiting room holding a folder on his lap, hopeful expression
shots.motion_prompt: he takes a slow breath, camera slowly pushes in
shots.narration: Then Ethiopian Airlines opened a sponsored trainee pilot program. I applied.

shots.reason: Builds momentum: stage after stage, passed.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a desk with an exam paper with no readable writing, a pen, and a rubber stamp pressing down, warm desk lamp light
shots.motion_prompt: the stamp presses down onto the paper, camera static
shots.narration: Age. Documents. Written test. Passed. Interview. Passed.

shots.reason: The high point: the last two stages passed, in the same plain rhythm, right before the medical.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, medium close-up from the chest up, sitting in a flight simulator cockpit, his face lit by glowing instrument panels, focused and calm, looking ahead through the windscreen, hands out of frame below the bottom edge
shots.motion_prompt: instrument lights flicker on his face, he glances up, camera very slowly pushes in
shots.narration: Simulation test. Passed. English proficiency. Passed.

shots.reason: Tension: the last test. The music drops away here.
shots.image_prompt: an empty eye examination room with no people, an eye chart far away on the wall so out of focus that no letters can be read, a bright examination lamp in the foreground, cool clinical light
shots.motion_prompt: the lamp light flares softly, camera static
shots.narration: One test left. The medical. My eyes.

shots.reason: The twist, carried by one image: the plane reflected in the eye that failed.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, extreme close-up of the young man's brown eye, a tiny airliner reflected in the iris, a single tear forming
shots.motion_prompt: the eye blinks slowly, camera static
shots.narration: Not cleared. Two words, and the sky closed.

shots.reason: Grief, given space before the turn.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, wide night view, the young man sitting on the same Addis rooftop with his head down, blinking aircraft lights crossing a dark blue sky above him, cool moonlight
shots.motion_prompt: aircraft lights move slowly across the sky, camera static
shots.narration: For weeks, I couldn't look up.

shots.reason: The turn: curiosity outlived the rejection, and this film is the proof.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, medium shot, the young man at a desk at night, laptop screen showing painted frames of airplanes and rooftops, a small smile returning, warm lamp light
shots.motion_prompt: he leans toward the screen, camera slowly pushes in
shots.narration: But the sky never asked for my eyes. It asked for my curiosity. So I kept learning, and I built this.

shots.reason: Mirrors the opening shot so the ending lands: same rooftop, same dawn, now standing.
shots.image_prompt: one man alone, wide shot, Addis Ababa rooftops at dawn, the young man standing on a flat roof, head tilted up, following a distant airliner drawing a white contrail across a gold sky
shots.motion_prompt: the contrail slowly extends, a light breeze moves his jacket, camera static
shots.narration: My eyes failed one test. My curiosity hasn't failed one yet. I'm not done looking up.

music.caption: instrumental cinematic ambient score, warm analog synth pads, soft felt piano, gentle strings, hopeful and reflective, slow build, airy texture, no vocals

cues.description: Music drops out; only the voice
The opening theme returns quietly, then lifts

A true story.
